verdict.rationale: Ramp explicitly documents background-agent automation: the agent-identity model states 'Long-running access — for background agents that run on a schedule,' standalone agents can authenticate headlessly via OAuth client-credentials (no browser) for scripted automation, webhooks push event-driven triggers, and spend programs/funds back recurring, unattended agent purchases — all gated by scoped OAuth (live-verified 401+scopes on mcp.ramp.com) and audit logging. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of a real autonomous background deployment, and the documented 24h read-write MCP session expiry is a caveat on truly indefinite unattended runs.
